figures.name: eval-fixed-event-wct
figures.title: 固定追加故障对同一Workflow的WCT影响
figures.caption: 固定追加故障对同一 Workflow 的 WCT 影响。K1 和 K2 均在 60 s 对 GPU 0 注入一次故障；K2 仅额外在 180 s 对 GPU 2 注入一次故障，每次停机 120 s。每点为同系统、同 ID 的 WCT(K2)−WCT(K1)，不是相对无故障条件的增量；负值完整保留。横轴是三系统在追加故障中直接 active/queued 受害 Workflow 的共同并集，共 7 个对象，按已有 Mooncake 无故障 WCT 顺序排列，三系统均展示同一组对象。实心表示含 active 受害请求，空心表示只有 queued 受害请求，叉号表示该系统无直接受害请求；同时包含 active 和 queued 时采用实心。此并集是事后描述性分组，不是预定义因果 cohort，不代表全部 160 个 Workflow 的效果。每个系统每种日程一次模拟，共复用 6 次执行；7 个对象并非独立重复，连线只帮助按 ID 对照。该图不单独证明 Peer HBM 恢复收益。
figures.caption_en: Effect of one fixed added fault on the same workflows. K1 and K2 share the GPU 0 fault at 60 s; K2 adds only a GPU 2 fault at 180 s, with 120 s downtime per fault. Each point is the same-system, same-ID difference WCT(K2) minus WCT(K1), not a fault-free contrast; negative values are retained. All three systems show the same seven-workflow union of directly active or queued victims at the added fault, in the existing Mooncake fault-free WCT order. Filled markers indicate active victims (including workflows also having queued victims), hollow markers queued-only victims, and crosses no direct victim. This is a post-treatment descriptive union, not a prespecified causal cohort or an estimate for all 160 workflows. One simulation per system per schedule, reusing six executions; workflows are not independent repeats, and connecting lines only aid same-ID comparison. The figure alone does not establish a Peer HBM recovery benefit.

prefix_audit.scope: All three systems: equality of 32 streams of saved semantic telemetry over [0,180s), with documented crossing-boundary masks and excluded allocation IDs/physical Python CPU. Not serialized DES heap equivalence or within-timestamp cross-stream order equality.

boundary.at_boundary_events_excluded: 180s injection and 60s-fault repair at180s are outside strict prefix

plot_spec.question: How does adding the fixed 180 s fault change each displayed workflow's WCT?
plot_spec.victim_state: active precedence, then queued-only, otherwise no direct victim
plot_spec.overlapping_zero_crosses: different marker sizes retain both exact coordinates; no jitter

reference.borrowed: same system colors, line patterns, independent legend band, absolute seconds and zero line

review.method: Actual native PNG plus PyMuPDF-rendered 7-inch PDF at 144 dpi; separate grayscale PDF rendering viewed with view_image.
checks: Both legend rows readable and separate from data; full three-system names.
PDF minimum text size 10 pt; all text stays inside the 7 x 3.4 inch page.
Complete 21 points on the same seven Workflow IDs and existing Mooncake F0 order.
Active/queued-only/no-direct flags match source rows; active takes precedence for mixed victims.
All four negative and three exact-zero differences retained; negative ticks and zero baseline visible.
Nested exact-zero crosses preserve both DRAM-only and AegisKV at b6f7c88d without jitter.
Solid/dashed/dash-dot lines remain distinct in grayscale.
No numerical aggregate across heterogeneous raw WCT and no Peer recovery claim.
